info.title: Lebanese Legislation API
info.description: Public read-only access to Lebanese legislation and legal sources. No authentication required. Not legal advice. Source texts come from the Lebanese University's Centre for Research and Studies in Legal Informatics. English discovery titles and machine readings are unofficial. DB-backed routes are rate limited and may return 429 or 503 as plain text. Successful responses use public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300, except calculated-current which has no cache header. JSON errors use no-store. Paths include their trailing slash where registered.

get.description: Public API entry point and links. No authentication required.
Machine-readable API description. No database required.

get.summary: Search legislation, articles, rulings and gazette issues
get.description: Exact text and citation results, with optional related passages. Counts are totals before pagination. The year filter applies to laws. Missing or malformed integer parameters use their defaults.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words, citation or question to search. Empty or 200 or more Unicode characters returns empty results. No matches may trigger a translated or adjusted search.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Restrict results to one collection. Empty or unrecognized values search all four.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Issue year filter for laws; 0 means no year filter. Integers are clamped.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results per collection; integers are clamped.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Result offset; integers are clamped.

parameters.name: semantic
parameters.description: Set exactly true for related source passages at offset zero. Ordinary search remains available if semantic retrieval fails.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Set exactly true with semantic=true to select related passages using a model.

503.description: Database queue is full or the request was cancelled.

text/plain.example: the server is busy, try again shortly
